title: Inverse restriction on module stalks respects scalars
statement: For schemes Y,Z, an open immersion j:Y→Z, a point z of Y, a module sheaf M on Z, a scalar d in O_Z,jz, and x in M_jz, let r be the inverse additive restriction stalk comparison restrictStalkNatIso j z. Then r(d • x) = j.stalkMap(z)(d) • r(x), where the right action is that of O_Y,z on the stalk of restrictFunctor j M. There are no flatness, finiteness or nonzero assumptions.

source.place: Restriction of germs, specialized to modules; coefficient-one and scalar-extension steps of the parent proof.

proof.text: Represent the scalar and restricted module element by section germs on a common open U. The inverse stalk ring map takes the scalar germ to the germ of the inverse appIso section. germ_smul and germ_restrictStalkNatIso_hom_app prove semilinearity of the forward restriction comparison over the inverse stalk map.

Apply injectivity of the forward additive restriction isomorphism to the desired equation. Apply its semilinearity formula to j.stalkMap(z)(d) and the inverse restriction image of x. The two ring inverse equations and the additive inverse equations simplify this formula to the desired equality.

lean.statement:
theorem restrictStalkNatIso_inv_smul
    {Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (j : Y ⟶ Z) [IsOpenImmersion j] (z : Y)
    (M : Z.Modules) (d : Z.presheaf.stalk (j z))
    (x : (RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor Z.toRingedSpace (j z)).obj M) :
    (restrictStalkNatIso j z).inv.app M (d • x) =
      (j.stalkMap z).hom d •
        (show (RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor Y.toRingedSpace z).obj
          ((restrictFunctor j).obj M) from (restrictStalkNatIso j z).inv.app M x)
